title: 第12章
content_zh:
电话那边的张处长直笑：老郭啊，你这几十年的官海生涯是不是白混了你，这事儿到现在还没想明白呢！
我的张大处长，张老弟，就指点指点你老哥我吧，再有下回我直接１２０完事。张老弟你要是这次帮了哥哥，那条熊猫送你了！郭主任是下了血本求教。
真的，说话算话啊，我可自己去你家取。看在咱们是一个部门出来的份上，要是别人再求我，我也不会多说一句。别的我也不好多说什么，不过我就提示你一件事，这好好的助理怎么就说换就换了呢？张处长语带暗示。
郭主任想了一下差点蹦起来：啊！老张你的意思不会是因为我没带夏真钰去开会，才、才被发作一通的吧？
张处长呵呵笑了：还不算太笨，老哥啊，你这可是糊涂一时了啊。
这、这也太小题大做了吧！周市长他老人家这算是公私不分哪。郭怀有些气不过。
老郭啊，你这是越活越回去了？你自己的工作错误摆在那儿呢，周市长发火发到什程度你控制得了？
我要是控制得了昨天还能差点倒在会议室？
你不能控制，有人能控制呀，不说了我还有会，自己参悟吧，那条熊猫给我准备好。说完张处长乐呵呵的挂了电话。
郭怀想了一会就明白了，苦笑一声，你说你周大市长受了气，被人家不待见，邪火倒都发到我身上来了，这肯定是周市长心愿还没达成呢。不过转念一想，这也是自己的机遇不是，夏真钰说到底还是自己大大的福将啊，自己能不能在退二线之前再提一格全看能不能处理好这件事了。
这么一想就觉得自己舍了珍藏已久的绝版好烟还是值得的，最起码大方向有了。
快下班时，夏真钰和李巍约好了去吃烤肉，结果郭主任一个电话把她叫上了楼，任务明确加班，给三倍工资，而且不能请假、必须加，因为时间紧、任务重，要写自查报告，报告不通过要被通报批评。
夏真钰看事情如此严重，只能打电话给李巍让他自己回家，自己留下来加班，难怪郭主任昨晚没回家，原来已经这么严重了，到底出了多大的错儿啊。
信息中心整个部门也都跟着加班，自查数据写技术报告，夏真钰问郭主任自己做什么，结果只得到一句话，做好加班同志们的后勤工作，其他事不用管。
夏真钰无语，后勤工作不就是买盒饭、送点水吗？至于让自己陪着加班吗，不过平时郭主任也没少照顾自己，加就加吧，按人数订了套餐，由于涉＼密单位电脑都不能上网，自己只能对着电脑玩扫雷。
加班加到后半夜，郭主任亲自送夏真钰回家，而且一直等到夏真钰打了电话，李巍下楼来接她才让司机把车开走，这倒让李巍感慨一阵，说夏真钰单位领导好，这样以后她加班加得再晚自己也都放心了。
夏真钰却一阵心烦，刚才在车上郭主任说了，明天上报自查报告时自己得和他一起去，她刚想找理由不去，就被郭主任上纲上线的说了一通，结果一下把工作提高到了政治高度，自己连拒绝的余地都没有了。
再烦也躲不去，夏真钰和郭怀一起去了市政府，夏真钰看着郭怀胸有成竹的样子和前天真是判若两人，估计是托了人情了，报告肯定能过关。
小夏，你帮我给张处长打个电话，问问我们得等多长时间周市长才有空听汇报？
夏真钰答应一声，拨了张处长的手机。

周市长，一会儿区办事大厅的郭怀郭主任要过来交自查报告，您不亲自看看？张处长恭敬的看着周瑾宇，想着老郭啊，我可绝不白收你的烟啊，自己可是帮忙帮到底了。
周瑾宇冷哼一声说道：有什么好看的，当我每次都那么好性儿的任他出错儿？什么时候我得直接对着一个区里干部办公了，让他们区长看着办吧！
张处长擦了擦冷汗，别人都说周瑾宇是儒雅市长，可是真在一起工作了才知道，这位哪是好伺候的主儿，不但惹不起，而且凡是触了这大爷霉头的人最后都是发配边疆守一辈子也升不了半格儿，整个儿一个活阎王。
不敢再多说话，偏这时手机响了起来，赶紧接了起来生怕铃声让这尊大佛心烦：喂，哪位？张处长直接用气儿说话。
这张处长是开会呢吧，要不怎么声音这么奇怪，于是夏真钰也下意识放低了声音：您好，张处长，我是信息中心小夏，我们郭主任让我问问您周市长得多长时间才有空听我们的自查报告。
张处长刚想说让你们郭主任回区里向区长汇报吧，却突然灵光一闪，小夏？瞄了眼看文件的周瑾宇，心想郭怀你还真上道儿，讲电话声音一下子大了许多：什么？我这边信号不太好，你是哪位？小夏，夏真钰？哦！我想起来了你是郭主任的助理是吧，找我有什么事？
说到这又偷瞄了一眼周瑾宇，果然周瑾宇放下文件往他这边看过来，他赶紧站好：小夏啊，是这样的你和你们郭主任说下，周市长可能临时有事不能亲自听报告了。啊，你们已经到了啊，那行，先在我办公室等下，我这就过去亲自和郭主任说。
说完按了手机想和周瑾宇说自己先去处理这件事，结果周大市长已经直接开了办公室的门往外走了，出去前只说了声：去小会议室。
张处长暗笑，看来自己还得和郭怀打好关系才行啊，毕竟夏真钰可是他的下属，到时自己的好处也是少不了的，能成为周瑾宇的心腹以后自己在官场可是无往不利了，于是乐呵呵的跟了过去。
作者有话要说：光光多么、多么希望看了文的亲们能留下二三个字啊，如果不知道说什么，那么光光有现成的模版供大家复制、粘贴，模版如下：
我爱光光！
哇哈哈哈哈哈，乃们想吐了不？
ＰＳ：ＥＤ大家还是百度一下子好了，如果不乐意查，那么往下看╯▽╰
ＥＤ：主要是指持续不能达到或者维持勃＼起以满足。
☆、波澜乍起
刚才在电话里听张处长说周瑾宇今天不在，夏真钰挺高兴的，她可不想自己好不容易用实际行动平息下去的谣言，被周瑾一个态度不明的眼神或者一个似是而非的动作又惹起是非。正美呢，结果会议室的门关人员，就有点傻眼，但也只能随着郭主任一起迎上前去。
夏真钰站在郭主任后面低着头，听他们互相打过招呼后，周瑾宇便入座示意可以开始报告，郭主任先是一番声情并茂的个人检讨，态度诚恳。
这次出现的问题，主要是我这个领头儿的没有认识到位，工作没有抓上来，我愧对领导对我的信任，但是我必须说我们基层工作人员都是极其认真负责的，不管职务大小都能以工作为己任。就拿我身边的这位夏真钰同志来说，虽然只是负责行政工作方面的事情，可是昨天依然坚持和信息中心的人加班到凌晨２点多，并且第二天仍然坚持上班不迟到，所以说我们单位的整体工作氛围是非常好的！
夏真钰记录写不下去了，迅速的瞄了一眼还在滔滔不绝的郭怀，心想真是老奸巨滑这是自检呢还是自夸呢，再说拿自己举例子做什么，真是受不了，夏真钰头又往下低了低。
周瑾宇边听边微微点头，这个郭怀还总算不糊涂没拿下属开脱，听提到夏真钰跟着加班了，眼神不着痕迹的扫了一眼脑袋快贴在会议桌上的夏真钰，笑容扩大了，看来她还是在意自己的。虽说是为了工作，可夏真钰这个职务有没有她加班都无所谓，所以她主动留下加班还是说明了她对自己的关心。周瑾宇很美好的分析着夏真钰的举动，越想心情越好，虽然已经决定不和她有什么联系，但自己看中的人对自己不是无动于衷感的觉就是不错。

随意周瑾宇脸上表情的变化，张处长、郭怀很有默契的对视了一下，郭怀更是放了一百二十个心，知道自己自检报告这一关一定会轻松过。
见好就收的结束了发言，郭怀主动请周瑾宇处罚自己，周瑾宇笑得和善，说道：郭主任你的自检报告很深刻啊，大家有什么想法都表表态。
其余众人互相交换了眼神，心想顶头上司都已经说深刻了，他们还能说不好么，都附和着说郭主任虽然缺乏主观能动性，但认识到位，相信将来会把工作做好的。
周瑾宇等大家都表了态，才慢悠悠的说：既然大家意见统一，那么郭主任我们就以观后效了。
郭怀立即起身鞠躬：是、是我一定对组织负责、对领导负责！
周瑾宇让他坐下又接着说：办事大厅的同志们都很不容易，特别是信息中心的工作人员更是辛苦。这样吧，明晚蓝海明珠我请大家放松一下。嗯，郭主任，你召集下你们单位的全体同志，明天一个都不要缺席，加班的人员除了加班费，最好也轮休一下。
市长放心，我都已经安排好了，加班费是按三倍工资发的，轮休从后天开始，我代表全体办事大厅的同志们感谢周市长对他们的厚爱。郭主任又深深的给周瑾宇鞠了一躬，连带着夏真钰也坐不住了，跟着一起弯了腰。
在回单位的路上，郭主任对夏真钰说：小夏啊，明天晚上家里安排好啊，让你爱人别着急，告诉他无论多晚，我老郭都亲自把你送到家门口。
郭主任，您太客气了，我呆到八点半您看行吗，也没人会注意我在不在场。夏真钰知道明天这酒宴对他们单位来说可是无上的荣耀，明晚过后他们单位的人在全区政府机关、企事业单位走路都有风了，所以这种气氛下自己无论如何也不能缺席。
content_en:
Director Zhang on the other side of the phone laughed: Lao Guo, have you spent these decades in officialdom in vain? I still haven’t figured it out yet!
My Director Zhang, Brother Zhang, please give me some pointers. Next time I will do it directly with 120. Brother Zhang, if you help me this time, the panda will be given to you! Director Guo spent a lot of money to ask for advice.
Really, keep your word, I can go to your house to pick it up myself. Considering that we are from the same department, if others beg me again, I will not say a word. I don’t know much else to say, but I will remind you one thing. Why did this good assistant just change at the drop of a hat? Director Zhang’s words were suggestive.
Director Guo thought for a moment and almost jumped up: Ah! Lao Zhang, you don't mean that you got angry because I didn't take Xia Zhenyu to the meeting, right?
Director Zhang chuckled: You are not too stupid, brother, you have been confused for a while.
This, this is too much to make a fuss about! Mayor Zhou and his elders do not distinguish between public and private matters. Guo Huai was a little angry.
Lao Guo, are you going back as you live longer? Where are your own work mistakes? To what extent can you control Mayor Zhou's anger?
If I could have controlled it, could I have almost collapsed in the conference room yesterday?
You can't control it, but someone can control it. I don't have to say that I still know how to do it, so you can understand it yourself. That panda is ready for me. After speaking, Director Zhang happily hung up the phone.
Guo Huai thought for a while and then understood, and gave a wry smile. You said that Mayor Zhou was angry and disliked by others, and the evil anger was directed at me. This must be because Mayor Zhou's wish has not been fulfilled. But then I thought about it, this is my opportunity, isn't it? Xia Zhenyu is still my great blessing after all. Whether I can raise another issue before retreating to the second line depends on whether I can handle this matter.
When I think about it, I feel that it is worth giving up the out-of-print good cigarettes that I have collected for a long time. At least I have a general direction.
When they were about to get off work, Xia Zhenyu and Li Wei made an appointment to have barbecue. However, Director Guo called her upstairs and told her to work overtime for three times the salary. She could not ask for leave and had to work overtime because time was tight and the task was heavy. She had to write a self-examination report. If the report failed, she would be notified and criticized.
Seeing that the matter was so serious, Xia Zhenyu could only call Li Wei and ask him to go home and stay and work overtime. No wonder Director Guo didn't go home last night. It turned out to be so serious. How big of a mistake had gone wrong.
The entire department of the information center also worked overtime, self-examining data and writing technical reports. Xia Zhenyu asked Director Guo what he was doing, but he only got one sentence: Do a good job in the logistics work of the comrades working overtime, and don't worry about other things.
Xia Zhenyu was speechless. Isn't the logistics work just buying lunch boxes and sending some water? As for whether he should accompany him to work overtime, Director Guo usually takes care of himself, so he can add more people. He ordered a package based on the number of people. Since the computers in the confidential units cannot access the Internet, he can only play minesweeper on the computer.
After working overtime until midnight, Director Guo personally sent Xia Zhenyu home, and waited until Xia Zhenyu called and Li Wei came downstairs to pick her up before letting the driver drive away. This made Li Wei sigh with emotion and said that Xia Zhenyu's unit has a good leader, so that she would feel relieved no matter how late she worked overtime in the future.
Xia Zhenyu was upset for a while. Director Guo had just said in the car that she would have to go with him when submitting the self-examination report tomorrow. She was just about to find a reason not to go, but Director Guo said something online. As a result, the work was raised to a political level, and she had no room to refuse.
No matter how annoying he was, he couldn't hide away. Xia Zhenyu and Guo Huai went to the city hall together.
Xiaoxia, please help me call Director Zhang and ask how long we have to wait before Mayor Zhou is free to listen to the report?
summerZhenyu agreed and dialed Director Zhang's cell phone.
Mayor Zhou, Director Guo Huaiguo from the district office will come over soon to hand in a self-examination report. Why don’t you take a look for yourself? Director Zhang looked at Zhou Jinyu respectfully, thinking, Lao Guo, I will never take your cigarettes in vain, I will help you to the end.
Zhou Jinyu snorted coldly and said: What's so good about it, when I am so good-natured and let him make mistakes every time? When will I have to work directly with a district cadre? Let their district chief take care of it!
Director Zhang wiped his cold sweat. Others said that Zhou Jinyu was an elegant mayor, but when we actually worked together, we realized that this master was not easy to serve. Not only was he untouchable, but anyone who got into trouble with him would end up being sent to the border guard without being able to get even a promotion in his lifetime. He was a living king of hell.
I didn't dare to say any more, but my cell phone rang at this moment. I quickly picked it up for fear that the ringing would upset the big Buddha: Hello, who is this? Director Zhang spoke directly with anger.
The director was in a meeting, otherwise the voice was so strange, so Xia Zhenyu lowered his voice subconsciously: Hello, director Zhang, I am Xiaoxia from the information center. Director Guo asked me to ask you how long it will take before Mayor Zhou is free to listen to our self-examination report.
Director Zhang was just about to say that you, Director Guo, should go back to the district and report to the district chief, but suddenly an idea flashed, Xiaoxia? Glancing at Zhou Jinyu who was looking at the documents, he thought to himself, Guo Huai, you are really wise. His voice on the phone suddenly became much louder: What? The signal here is not very good, who are you? Xiaoxia, Xia Zhenyu? oh! I remembered that you are Director Guo's assistant, right? What do you want from me?
Having said this, he took another peek at Zhou Jinyu, and sure enough, Zhou Jinyu put down the document and looked over to him. He quickly stood up and said, "Xiao Xia, this is what you want to tell Director Guo. Mayor Zhou may not be able to listen to the report in person because of something else." Ah, you are already here. Okay, wait in my office for a moment. I will go over and talk to Director Guo in person.
After speaking, he pressed the phone and wanted to tell Zhou Jinyu that he would deal with the matter first. As a result, Mayor Zhou Da had already opened the door of the office and walked out. Before going out, he only said: Go to the small conference room.
Director Zhang secretly chuckled. It seemed that he had to establish a good relationship with Guo Huai. After all, Xia Zhenyu was his subordinate, and he would benefit from it. If he could become Zhou Jinyu's confidant, he would have no disadvantages in the officialdom, so he followed happily.

☆. A sudden upheaval
Xia Zhenyu was very happy to hear Director Zhang say on the phone that Zhou Jinyu was not here today. She didn't want the rumors that she had finally put down with practical actions to stir up trouble again with an unclear look or a specious action from Zhou Jin. As for Zhengmei, the doorman in the conference room was a little dumbfounded, but they could only follow Director Guo to greet her.
Xia Zhenyu stood behind Director Guo with his head lowered. After listening to them greet each other, Zhou Jinyu took his seat and signaled that he could start the report. Director Guo first gave an emotional personal review with a sincere attitude.
The main problem that occurred this time was that I, the leader, did not realize that I was in charge and did not catch up on the work. I am ashamed of the trust that the leadership placed in me, but I must say that our grassroots staff are extremely serious and responsible, and they can take their work as their own responsibility regardless of their position. Take Comrade Xia Zhenyu next to me as an example. Although he is only responsible for administrative work,However, yesterday I still insisted on working overtime with the people in the information center until past 2 o'clock in the morning, and I still insisted on not being late for work the next day, so the overall working atmosphere of our unit is very good!
Xia Zhenyu couldn't write any more, and quickly glanced at Guo Huai, who was still talking. He thought to himself that he was really a treacherous person. Is this a self-examination or a self-examination? Besides, why should I use myself as an example? I couldn't stand it, so Xia Zhenyu lowered his head again.
Zhou Jinyu nodded slightly while listening. Guo Huai was finally clear and did not excuse his subordinates. When he heard that Xia Zhenyu was working overtime, he glanced at Xia Zhenyu whose head was almost pressed against the conference table. His smile widened. It seemed that she still cared about him. Although it was for work, it didn't matter whether Xia Zhenyu worked overtime in this position, so her initiative to stay and work overtime still showed that she cared about herself. Zhou Jinyu analyzed Xia Zhenyu's actions very beautifully, and the more he thought about it, the better he felt. Although he had decided not to have any contact with her, the person he liked felt that he was either indifferent to him or that he was good.
Randomly changing the expression on Zhou Jinyu's face, Director Zhang and Guo Huai looked at each other in a tacit understanding. Guo Huai was even more relieved, knowing that he would pass the self-examination report easily.
After he finished his speech, Guo Huai took the initiative to ask Zhou Jinyu to punish him. Zhou Jinyu smiled kindly and said: Director Guo, your self-examination report is very profound. Everyone should express their opinions.
The rest of the people exchanged glances with each other, thinking that their immediate superiors had already said that they were profound, so how could they say otherwise? They all agreed that although Director Guo lacked subjective initiative, he was aware of his position and believed that he would do a good job in the future.
Zhou Jinyu waited for everyone to express their position, and then said slowly: Since everyone has the same opinion, Director Guo, we will wait and see what the consequences are.
Guo Huai immediately stood up and bowed: Yes, I must be responsible for the organization and the leadership!
Zhou Jinyu asked him to sit down and continued: It is not easy for the comrades in the service hall, especially the staff in the information center. Well, let me ask you all to relax tomorrow night at Blue Sea Pearl. Well, Director Guo, please summon all the comrades in your unit. No one should be absent tomorrow. In addition to overtime pay, those who work overtime should also take turns.
Don’t worry, mayor, I have already made arrangements. Overtime pay will be paid at three times the salary, and the rotation will start the day after tomorrow. On behalf of all the comrades in the office, I would like to thank Mayor Zhou for his kindness to them. Director Guo bowed deeply to Zhou Jinyu again, and even Xia Zhenyu couldn't sit still and bent down together.
On the way back to the unit, Director Guo said to Xia Zhenyu: Xiaoxia, please make arrangements at home tomorrow night. Tell your lover not to worry, and tell him that no matter how late it is, I, Lao Guo, will personally deliver you to your door.
Director Guo, you are too polite. Do you think it is okay if I stay until 8:30? No one will notice whether I am there or not. Xia Zhenyu knew that tomorrow's banquet would be a supreme honor for his unit. After tomorrow night, people from his unit would feel uncomfortable walking around government agencies, enterprises and institutions in the region, so he could not be absent in this atmosphere no matter what.
